mathematical_experience.lesson: Every legal shared integral m-pair full cover yields an acyclic construction with at most m^2 intersections; this is an already-known construction upper bound, not an explicit-target lower-bound certificate.

The cyclic optimum equals r=rho and is at most arbitrary witness size m; mere renaming therefore creates no distinct certificate, though a substantively new proof in the cyclic representation is not ruled out.
The source encoding bound becomes a lower bound only after an independently justified target description lower bound; random incompressibility does not transfer to an explicit target by analogy.

Fusion and cover theorems with ultrafilter, linear-function, generator-derived-operand, canonical-only, or other restricted obligation classes cannot be imported into the unrestricted full-semi-filter object without an explicit assumption-preserving translation.
The inspected graph-to-Boolean fusion map preserves the needed above and upward-closure relations only in the proved direction; the inequality cannot be silently reversed.

The G_NEQ lower bound normalizes canonical covering pairs through a target-specific recursive row/column-span proof; it does not authorize normalization of arbitrary full noncanonical semi-filter obligations.
Under the exact frozen R1 predicate, known T24 and T30 bounds count as MATCH; novelty, distinctness, lower-bound polarity, or explicit-target usefulness cannot be inserted after result access.

Razborov 1989 gives a genuine cubic reconstruction relation from pair-cover size inside an f-dependent legitimate model, but its selected functional family and literal-pair overhead must be translated before use for every full Definition-21 semi-filter cover.

Wigderson 1993 gives a polynomial cover-to-program converse with exponent at most four within each explicitly paired model, cover class, and input definition; discarding the row restrictions would change the mathematical object.
